implementation_mapping.implementation: createRuntimeState initializes B to 0, terminalRound to false, sets currentContext to initialContext, and runs under supplied config in runHierarchicalEvaluation.
resolveIteratorForB evaluates state.B at the start of each round against configured B_rules and resolves complete iterator configuration before context division.

divideContextIntoBatches, createDivisionUnits, and shiftDivisionBoundariesUntilFit call the single runtime countTokens function to verify max_tokens once per batch assignment, shifting boundaries until fits, producing an ordered batch sequence.
state.b is initialized to 0 at the start of each round, indexing batches sequentially in the inner loop.
assembleEvaluatorInput creates a fresh invocation input containing batch.context, task, criteria, and response_contract without rechecking assigned context size.
invokeGemini dispatches invocation through the Gemini interface or environment convention, capturing response, status, and system errors in executeEvaluatorAttempt.

executeRetryConditionals evaluates configured retry conditionals in sequential order, building fresh invocations with named inputs while reusing batch context without rechecking max_tokens, stopping at the first success or applying configured terminal behavior.
normalizeEvaluatorResponse, tryParseJson, requiredFieldsRecoverable, and extractFieldsFromMalformedSerialization parse and recover required response contract fields without extra model calls.

evaluateAcceptanceConditions evaluates observable conditions including invocation status, field recovery, and response token count against thresholds derived from divider.max_tokens via the single countTokens function without remeasuring assigned context.

createTerminalBatchResult and commitBatchResult record the final terminal status, response, tokens, and metadata for b; failed batches contribute no evaluator response to subsequent rounds while remaining visible.
evaluateFailedBatchStopCondition evaluates supervisory failed_b_count after each batch terminates, returning configured program failure return when satisfied or continuing sequential b execution.
runHierarchicalEvaluation advances state.b by 1 only after batch result is committed and supervisory check passes, sequentially processing all batches in the round.

aggregateSuccessfulBatchResults filters round batches to retain only successful responses, counts their tokens via countTokens, sets aggregateResponseTokens, serializes context, and preserves provenance.

Post-round logic in runHierarchicalEvaluation returns immediately if terminalRound was already true; otherwise evaluates termination condition and sets state.terminalRound = true without bypassing the normal next-round division/evaluation path.

When non-terminal, runHierarchicalEvaluation sets state.currentContext to aggregate.context, increments B by 1, resolves B configuration, divides and assigns b batches; completion of the terminal round returns directly without another cycle.
aggregateSuccessfulBatchResults, createDivisionUnits, and divideContextIntoBatches preserve batch IDs and ancestry chains across rounds without requiring full source retransmission.
All token sizing throughout the runtime (context assignment check, acceptance condition evaluation, round response token aggregation) routes exclusively through the single async countTokens function.
assembleProgramReturn and resolveReturnEnvelope map runtime, round, aggregate, and reason data into the configured program return envelope upon terminal round completion or stopping condition.
config.json defines B_rules with B=0 and B>0 rules containing complete configurable iterator definitions for base and reduction rounds.
Evaluator configuration defines task, criteria, model, and response_contract as declarative data interpreted by the runtime.
config.json configures divider.max_tokens and boundary_strategy; audit.js checks max_tokens once at context assignment and keeps task/criteria/contract outside max_tokens.
Acceptance condition response_below_hard_token_limit configures response token threshold as divider.max_tokens / 2 using resolveConfiguredValue with divide_by: 2.
config.json defines ordered retry conditionals with condition matching, inputs, success retention, and terminal failure behaviors.
system_error_retry conditional repeats original invocation once on system_error, failing b if the repeat fails and advancing subject to supervisory stop logic.

mechanical_response_retry conditional executes one fresh corrective invocation receiving context, previous_response, mechanical_error, task, criteria, and response_contract, retaining latest response with failure metadata if still unacceptable.
Acceptance conditions inspect mechanically observable properties: invocation.status eq success, required_fields_recoverable eq true, and response.tokens lt divider.max_tokens / 2.
Termination condition evaluates round.aggregate_response_tokens <= divider.max_tokens to set terminal_round before advancing into the final round.
failed_b_stop configuration defines supervisory stopping threshold over supervisory.failed_b_count, evaluated while all b batches remain visible.
config.json configures program_return.envelope as a configurable projection assembled by assembleProgramReturn.
config.json configures evaluator response_contract with required_fields and schema, providing the basis for normalization and mechanical acceptance.
